requirements.title: Scheduled Execution at Static Period
requirements.description: The AFM app shall execute on the scheduler at a fixed compile-time period.
requirements.rationale: Parent SYS-010 mandates a static compile-time schedule for deterministic TDM execution of all apps.

requirements.title: Sensor Message Subscription
requirements.description: The AFM app shall subscribe to IMU, barometer, and GPS sensor messages on the software bus.
requirements.rationale: PM-required AFM capability per SYS-016 needs sensor measurements to drive flight phase detection.

requirements.title: Navigation State Subscription
requirements.description: The AFM app shall subscribe to navigation state messages on the software bus.
requirements.rationale: PM-required AFM capability per SYS-016 uses nav state alongside sensors to detect flight phases.

requirements.title: Phase Detection Update Per Cycle
requirements.description: The AFM app shall update the flight phase detection state each scheduled cycle using received messages.
requirements.rationale: PM-required AFM capability per SYS-016 mandates ongoing phase detection during the mission.

requirements.title: Current Flight Phase Publication
requirements.description: The AFM app shall publish the current flight phase on the software bus each scheduled cycle.
requirements.rationale: Parent SYS-017 requires the current flight phase to be observable on the bus for telemetry and logging.

requirements.title: Phase Transition Timestamp Publication
requirements.description: The AFM app shall publish a timestamp on the software bus for each detected flight phase transition.
requirements.rationale: Parent SYS-018 requires transition timestamps to support post-flight ground-truth comparison within one second.

requirements.title: Defined Flight Phase Set
requirements.description: The AFM app shall report flight phase as one of pre-launch, boost, apogee, descent, or landing.
requirements.rationale: Parent SYS-016 mandates detection of boost, apogee, descent, and landing phases plus pre-launch ground state.

requirements.title: Fault Isolation From Other Apps
requirements.description: The AFM app shall not prevent other applications from executing when its own execution fails.
requirements.rationale: Parent SYS-062 mandates apps continue at static rates when phase detection is unavailable.

requirements.title: POSIX and Flight Build Equivalence
requirements.description: The AFM app shall produce identical published phase outputs on POSIX and flight builds for identical inputs.
requirements.rationale: Parent SYS-043 requires POSIX build to be functionally equivalent to flight build for Trick simulation fidelity.

requirements.title: Deterministic Phase Output
requirements.description: The AFM app shall produce deterministic phase outputs when given identical input message sequences.
requirements.rationale: Parent SYS-044 mandates deterministic FSW outputs for repeatable Trick sim runs and regression analysis.
